name: Wasa Sushi Bar
notes: 4 photos of 2 different printed menus (a full folded menu, photos 1-2, and an older leather-bound menu book, photo 3, plus a kids/military-discount insert, photo 4). Overlapping items (e.g. California Roll, Gyoza) appear on both physical menus at different prices/portions and were kept as separate line items rather than merged, since they are not the same printed page. The Beer/Wine/Sake section on photo 3 was skipped as drink-only.
